description.value:
You can give it directly. That is the entire mutation.

Gift — Once per day, open a vein as an action: an adjacent ally gains fast healing 2 for 1 minute, drawn out of you. Tithe — It comes out of you literally — 1 damage per round for the duration, unavoidable and not reducible by any resistance — and it can never be turned on yourself.

cinderfall.incomplete: The whole ability (once per day, open a vein to grant an adjacent ally fast healing 2 for 1 minute, at a cost of 1 unavoidable damage per round to yourself) has no rule-element equivalent: it targets another creature with a limited-use action, the same architecture gap as Loyal-Blood, and 'not reducible by any resistance' self-inflicted damage-over-time also has no confirmed hook.
